member_request_account_binding.scope: Request signature and account binding only. Certificate sources are actor_A from actors and same_account or different_account from signer_account_binding.cases. Session authorization, membership, invitations and request lifecycle are checked separately.

visibility.scope: Selector fixtures, not wire GroupEvent objects; current authorization is checked before selection. An interval is inclusive [start,end], with null for an open end.

encrypted_nicknames.scope: Encrypted nickname business objects, local nickname state assertions and display name examples. All fields outside event.payload are test inputs, assertions or examples, not additional wire fields. Fields named example_initial_display_names and example_display_names illustrate one possible display policy and are not protocol conformance assertions. Branch messages start from starting_event_index; local cases assume verified management history and stated current membership boundaries. Local nickname assertions describe logical state, not storage structures or persistence requirements. Relay sessions, retention timing, atomic protocol effects and crash recovery require separate behavioral tests.
